dialogue.adventurersguild.receptionist.s: Welcome to the Adventurer's Guild. I am Elaine, the receptionist. Registration and records are handled here.
dialogue.adventurersguild.receptionist.a: The guild is open to anyone willing to explore this world. The board refreshes daily - choose wisely and come back alive.
dialogue.adventurersguild.questmaster.st: I am Rod, the quest master. Daily contracts and quest chains are registered with me.
dialogue.adventurersguild.shopkeeper.sta: Need supplies? Mia has everything - as long as you have gold.
dialogue.adventurersguild.expedition_mas: I am Gray, the expedition master. Nether and End routes are arranged by me.
So you have been to the Nether. Remember: the Blazes guard the key to the End.
You defeated the Ender Dragon... This is not the end, only another beginning.
dialogue.adventurersguild.archivist.star: I am the archivist. Every adventure of yours is recorded here.
dialogue.adventurersguild.archivist.lore: The first master once said: 'The edge of the map is never the edge of the world.'
dialogue.adventurersguild.archivist.choi: Tell me about the guild's history
dialogue.adventurersguild.end_researcher: I am Silas, the End researcher. What lies beyond the dragon has no answer yet.
You slew the dragon. Now the real puzzle begins - outer islands, gateways, and the edge of the world.

lore.adventurersguild.LORE_001.title: The First Guild Record
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_001.text: On the guild's first day, someone carved into the oak pillar: 'Let the world know we were here.'
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_002.title: Adventurers of the Old Era
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_002.text: Old adventurers asked not for pay, but for the horizon. Most never returned, and left no names.
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_003.title: On the Nether
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_003.text: The Nether is not a hell. It is another map - its fires simply know directions better than we do.
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_004.title: The Unfinished Map
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_004.text: The archive holds a map without edges. It ends at a stronghold, its last stroke trailing like a sigh.
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_005.title: The First Master
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_005.text: The first master once walked into a Nether fortress alone. Three days later he returned with a blaze rod and said only: 'The door is behind.'
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_006.title: The Dragon
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_006.text: The dragon is no monster. It is a guardian chained at the end - keeping a secret it does not even know.
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_007.title: The End
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_007.text: The End is not an ending. The final page reads: 'Those who slay the dragon are only beginning to walk.'
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_008.title: The Blank Record
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_008.text: Deep in the stronghold lies a blank record with a name on the cover and nothing inside. Perhaps it belongs to someone in the future.
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_009.title: The Wither
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_009.text: Someone asked why the Wither exists. The archive gave no answer, only: 'Because it was summoned.'
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_010.title: The Broken End Map
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_010.text: The ships of the outer islands carry broken maps. Every route points to the same word: farther.
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_011.title: The Master's Notes
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_011.text: The master's notes: 'We record adventures, not victories. The fallen road is still a road.'
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_012.title: The Last Page
lore.adventurersguild.LORE_012.text: The last page holds a single line: 'The adventure never ends.' The ink is still fresh.
